steps.content: The familiar feeling of suffocating dread hits you.
You feel as if someone has dragged you into the pool again. You're unable to move your hands and feet.
All you can do is watch the air escape from your mouth bit by bit, before vanishing completely...
Where... where am I...
You're... on my plate...
Step by step, Cabernet closes the distance. All too soon, she's right in front of you. She reaches out her hand. The moment her fingers touch you, you feel your soul being separated from your body.
Your limbs go numb with cold, as if drained of life force.
Every nerve in your body seems to be shutting down. The only thing you're conscious of is a tickling sensation behind your ear when a soft voice whispers...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Time for me...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: To enjoy the fruits...
Milly
Was I having a nightmare?
The screen of your communications device is displaying the message you received an hour ago.
Cabernet, a Sinner who was the main figure involved in the banquet incident, has been detained. The MBCC is running a test to determine the nature and scale of her power.
Furthermore, the prime suspects, Carley and Greg, have been arrested by the FAC.
These two Mania-infected individuals turned up at the banquet as a human-mermaid chimera and caused mayhem.
They have been separated from the mermaid. No Mania residue has been detected in their bodies; their M-values are normal. But they are still mentally unstable.
They haven't been cooperative with the FAC investigators. Since Chief ${PlayerName} had contact with them before, the MBCC has been requested to assist in the investigation.
You look out of the window. Judging by the view outside, you're close to the destination now.
Carley and Greg are still mentally unstable...
You look down at the file in your hand.

[Results of Background Checks on Carley and Greg] Carley, Eastsider, 22 years of age, a servant working for Cabernet, missing for unknown reasons. Greg, Eastsider, 25 years of age, a junior-level chef who once applied to work for Cabernet as a private chef, missing around the same time as Carley for unknown reasons. The two missing persons might be a couple, according to the other servants working in the Cabernet household.
One name keeps popping up in the file.
<color=#fb9259>Cabernet</color>...
A knock on the window interrupts your train of thought.

steps.speaker: Communications
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, we've arrived at our destination. The clerk assigned to work with you is waiting in the sickroom.
You're greeted by a scene of chaos when the door of the sickroom opens.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: I know you've been traumatized. But we mean you no harm. Please put down the knife...
The clerk and guards stand around, not daring to get any closer.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: No! You have to prove you have no value to her. Say it, Greg, say it, say you don't love me. Prove to her yours is tasteless...

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: No, no, let her have me.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: That's why... That's why I should show her my love for you!
They talk as if there's no one else in the room. And then the man points the scalpel at his own throat, sending everyone else in the room into a panic.
That's what you see when you arrive at the sickroom.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: Finally, Chief of the MBCC! I've been waiting for you. They've been saying things that make no sense to me.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: Like "I've got to prove mine is tastier," "Say you don't love me," and things like that. All sound like lines from some crazy soap opera.
But they look nothing like characters in a soap opera.
You take a step towards them. They shriek in response.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: NO!! Don't take us away!

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: We don't want to be <color=#fb9259>locked up</color> again! Please leave us alone, please...
I have a basic knowledge of your situation. Don't be afraid. Tell me what exactly happened to...

steps.speaker: Both
steps.content: No!!
They shriek before you can finish the sentence.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Don't take us away!

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: We don't want to be <color=#fb9259>locked up</color> again! Please leave us alone, please...
Again?
Who locked you up? Cabernet?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Stop! Don't say her name.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Sh-she sent you here! You smell like her.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Cabernet Franc! She's here?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She's not here. She's kept under control by the MBCC. Please calm down...

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: That's not true! She's always here, watching us. She's planning to <color=#fb9259>consume our souls!</color>
The name Cabernet seems to fill them with dread.
Don't be afraid. She can't get her hands on you now.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

steps.speaker: Cabernet

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Her power is under control now. I won't let her hurt you again.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She must obey my commands, which means I can stop her from feeding on souls.
The red light emanating from your palm seems to have soothed their fears, even if temporarily.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Did you say she obeys you? That's impossible. She's from the Franc family.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: She's held in high regard by everyone. No one dares to offend her.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Any grievance against her is like a tiny pebble thrown into a deep river. No splash can be heard.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Exactly! There's no way you have her under your thumb. Unless... you're wealthier and more influential than the Franc family.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: If... if that's the case, can you take us under your wing? We'll be your most obedient servants!

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Wh-what's your name?
${PlayerName}, Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.
What my name is is not important. All you need to know is I'm here to help deal...

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: I heard them call you Chief, I'm sure.
He cuts you off, looking at you like you're their last hope of escape.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: This is good news, Carley. The Chief owns us now. Cabernet isn't a threat to us anymore.
Hand in hand, they lunge forward to try to hug you. Before they can get too close, however, the FAC people in the room stop them.
Please calm down. You're not owned by anyone. The FAC got you out of the banquet. You're free now.
Please tell me what Cabernet did to you. I promise I'll try my best to help you.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: No! We can't escape from her. We tried, but she caught us every time.
The two patients move away from you, shaking their heads and mumbling to themselves.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Greg, we're on our own. You've got to prove to her that you don't love me. Then she'll believe that you have no value to her.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Don't be silly, Carley. You know I won't be able to prove that. You should be the one who gets away. I dragged you into this...
Now they're back in soap opera mode, as the FAC clerk put it.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: They were like this in my previous dealings with them. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get them to believe that they had escaped the control of Cabernet.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: They seem to have lost their sense of self.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: I wonder...
The clerk looks up at you, opening and shutting her mouth.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: They have been seriously traumatized, to the point where they seem to have lost their sense of self.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: I believe your Sinner didn't just "lock them up" and "consume them." She must have done something much more terrible to them, even more terrible than...

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: Turning them into a human-mermaid chimera at the dinner party...
As if to confirm the clerk's suspicions, Carley and Greg dissolve into blood-curdling laughter.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: The red-haired witch, she's coming!

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Hahaha, are you here to feed on my soul again? All right, you can have it, all of it! But please let Greg go.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: This is no place for him, not at all. He hasn't fulfilled his dream of becoming a head chef...

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: You shouldn't say things like that, Carley. Don't you remember what that monster likes the most about you?

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: It's the way you stand up for me. Like what you're doing right now.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: I don't want to be a coward hiding behind you anymore. Let me bear the brunt. You must escape!

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Escape? Where to? No matter where I hide, she'll find me, even if I'm kept in a fish tank as a monster.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: It's Cabernet Franc. There's no escape from her.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Oh, I remember now. We're her "ingredients."

steps.speaker: Carley & Greg
steps.content: We...can't escape...
Carley and Greg pace the room, repeating how it's impossible to escape. You decide not to deal with the file in hand for the time being.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: With them so out of it, there's no chance of getting anything useful out of them. Would you relay this message to the FAC for me?

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: Sure thing. Are you going to...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, I'll talk to the source of their fears.
You can still hear that laughter of utter despair in your mind,yet Cabernet remains detached as you finish recounting your meeting with Carley and Greg.
Do you have anything to say about the way they reacted upon hearing your name?
You look up at the woman in front of you. To all appearances, she is listening with rapt attention. But you can't help noticing how her eyes are roaming all over you.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Of course I'm listening. I savor every word that comes out of your mouth.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I'm looking at you. I savor every expression that runs across your face.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why are you acting like it has nothing to do with you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The mere mention of your name filled them with so much dread.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Really? Didn't you tell them about our unforgettable encounter?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I've allowed you to use the shackles on me. I can't feed on souls when you activate them. There's no reason for them to be afraid of me.
Cabernet shrugs, somewhat ruefully.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I loved the way they behaved so bravely for each other. So yummy...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not just the clout you wielded that they feared, but the way you wielded it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They feared you so much that they threatened to end their own life if the other didn't stop loving them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You did more than just consume their souls, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Why are you so curious about what I did to them? Are you concerned about them, or...
She leans closer to you with anticipation.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Are you angry with me?

steps.speaker: Choose
options: I'm the one asking questions, not you.

choices.text: I'm the one asking questions, not you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now answer my question. What exactly did you do to them?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hahaha, you're more serious now as the Chief of the MBCC than when you were at the dinner party.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I like it when you're serious, though, and I also like this face-to-face format of questioning.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You want to know what I did to them?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Okay, I'll tell you all about it, morsel by morsel.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It'll give me a chance to...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Savor each of your reactions.
